A '''spectrometer''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It could be installed into a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] chassis.<ref name="RPG" /> [[SM-series scavenger droid]]s were equipped with spectrometers.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
